FEB 24 2025 MS. DIGNA CASTRO RAMOS, ET AL. Barangay Tayambani, San Carlos City Province of Pangasinan Dear Ms. Ramos,et al: This is in reply to an earlier letter requesting for this Department's Opinion on a matter concerning the allowances received by the Officials of Senior Citizens of the Philippines, San Carlos City Chapter. In your letter, you informed the Department of the following salient facts and circumstances: 1. As elected officials of the Federation of Senior Citizens you have been receiving the following amounts as monthly allowances: Php 3,000 for the Federation President; Php 2,000 for the Federation Treasurer; Php 1000 for the Federation Auditor; and Php 2,000 for the different Barangay Senior Citizen Presidents. 2. Said allowances are sourced from One Percent (1%) of the Senior Citizens from the annual budget of San Carlos City 3. These allowances are subsequently revoked without notice from the Finance Department of San Carlos City. Hence, the instant request for guidance. While there is no national law mandating LGUs to allocate 1% of their National Tax Allotment (NTA) for senior citizens, LGUs may do so under their discretion to promote general welfare, subject to budgetary laws and guidelines from the DBM and COA. However, allowances can be revoked if found inconsistent with legal or budgetary principles or due to fund unavailability. RA 9994 provides benefits for senior citizens but does not explicitly mandate allowances for federation officials, except an honorarium for the OSCA head. To wit, Section 6 of RA 99941, as amended, explicitly provides. "Section 6. xxx 1 "Expanded Senior Citizens Act of 2010" "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No. (02) 8876 3454

The head of the OSCA shall be entitled to receive an honorarium of an amount at least equivalent to Salary Grade to be approved by the LGU concerned. This opinion is based on your provided facts and is without prejudice to contrary rulings by other authorities or courts. We hope this clarifies your concern. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY ATT . ROMEO P. BENITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLÆRPBULLLS-LRALLD/jvpr/kbm Page 2 of 2
